minimalReproducerPlan: After root coordinates shared reservation, create a temporary diagnostic harness using the unchanged actual Zlagboard Evo package and normal BoardMapView/BoardModelSurface path. Keep viewport, position and two selected contact IDs fixed. Hold each phase until explicitly advanced, eliminating seven-second timing windows.

PhaseA selects active red; phaseB changes only mode to preview blue; phaseC changes only mode back to active. Retain full screenshots and CPU state at each settled checkpoint. No direct scene.highlight calls from test assertions. Require visual failure before adding a diagnostic perturbation.

Persist a bounded newline-complete state record directly to a dedicated diagnostic file (or explicitly flush every line) containing wallclock+uptime, phase sequence, RealityView identity, scene/root IDs, selected entity IDs and ancestor IDs, materials, isEnabled and attachment state. Capture before and after the screenshot window; records must include the final active phase. Avoid SwiftUI-body print instrumentation that changed reproduction timing previously.

When blue CPU/red screen is present, perform one controlled same-scene transform perturbation through the existing orbit path or a diagnostic visible marker. If the board visibly moves and pockets remain red while CPU stays blue, global drawable staleness is falsified and material-specific synchronization becomes the lead hypothesis. If neither moves, suspect render scheduling/viewport identity.

In a separate repeat, temporarily disable the exact logged selected entities, then restore. If colored contacts remain visible, the logged entities are not the displayed drawables or a stale frame persists. If they disappear, identity is established and their material transition can be isolated. This is diagnostic state only; no package geometry changes.

Only after identity/redraw are established, compare a generated PBR cube with the imported contact in the same RealityView under the same phase changes. If cube tint updates while imported contact does not, investigate imported mesh/material state; if both fail, investigate render scheduling/material pipeline. An Unlit versus PBR comparison can then isolate the material path.
